title: Don Quixote
synopsis: La Mancha. You read too many books and got the wrong ideas. Today you put on a rusted helmet and call your old horse Rocinante. You will be, you have decided, a knight.

nodes.text: Romances stacked to the ceiling.

choices.consequence: “Burn them later” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Pride.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Cardboard reinforced with a basin.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.

nodes.text: Your library is burned, with the priest's careful selection. Some are saved. The village reads them, occasionally, with skepticism.
Sancho tells your story to whoever stops at the inn. The story grows kinder as it travels. By a generation it is, in many ways, a kind of scripture.
An author named Cervantes hears the story. He writes it down. It outlives every kingdom you would have conquered. You become, against your will, a saint of imperfect courage.
